title: Indices of encoding ports
statement: For a natural number $k$ and a port, assign indices as follows: state, input head, and input symbol receive $0,1,2$; work-head port $i$ receives $3+i$; work-symbol port $(i,t)$ receives $3+k+2i+t$; summary port $t$ receives $3+3k+t$; and the old-bit and new-bit ports receive $5+3k$ and $6+3k$, respectively, where each Boolean value is identified with $0$ or $1$.
